sections.title: Example 1: Basic XGBoost with Default Parameters
sections.body:
```python
print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("Example 1: Basic XGBoost with Default Parameters")
print("=" * 80)

xgb_basic = xgb.XGBClassifier(random_state=42, eval_metric="logloss")

xgb_basic.fit(X_train, y_train)
y_pred = xgb_basic.predict(X_test)

print("Basic XGBoost Results:")
print(f"Accuracy: {accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred):.4f}")
print(f"Precision: {precision_score(y_test, y_pred):.4f}")
print(f"Recall: {recall_score(y_test, y_pred):.4f}")
print(f"F1-Score: {f1_score(y_test, y_pred):.4f}")

# Feature importance
feature_importance = xgb_basic.feature_importances_
print(f"\nTop 10 Feature Importance:")
top_features = np.argsort(feature_importance)[-10:]
for i, feature_idx in enumerate(top_features):
    print(f"Feature {feature_idx:2d}: {feature_importance[feature_idx]:.4f}")
```

sections.title: Example 2: XGBoost with Advanced Regularization
sections.body:
```python
print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("Example 2: XGBoost with Advanced Regularization")
print("=" * 80)

xgb_regularized = xgb.XGBClassifier(
    n_estimators=100,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    max_depth=6,
    reg_alpha=0.1,  # L1 regularization
    reg_lambda=1.0,  # L2 regularization
    subsample=0.8,  # Row sampling
    colsample_bytree=0.8,  # Column sampling
    random_state=42,
    eval_metric="logloss",
)

xgb_regularized.fit(X_train, y_train)
y_pred = xgb_regularized.predict(X_test)

print("Regularized XGBoost Results:")
print(f"Accuracy: {accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred):.4f}")
print(f"Precision: {precision_score(y_test, y_pred):.4f}")
print(f"Recall: {recall_score(y_test, y_pred):.4f}")
print(f"F1-Score: {f1_score(y_test, y_pred):.4f}")
```

sections.title: Example 3: XGBoost with Early Stopping
sections.body:
```python
print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("Example 3: XGBoost with Early Stopping")
print("=" * 80)

xgb_early_stop = xgb.XGBClassifier(
    n_estimators=1000,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    max_depth=6,
    random_state=42,
    eval_metric="logloss",
)

# Train with early stopping
xgb_early_stop.fit(
    X_train,
    y_train,
    eval_set=[(X_test, y_test)],
    early_stopping_rounds=20,
    verbose=False,
)

y_pred = xgb_early_stop.predict(X_test)

print("XGBoost with Early Stopping Results:")
print(f"Best iteration: {xgb_early_stop.best_iteration}")
print(f"Accuracy: {accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred):.4f}")
print(f"Precision: {precision_score(y_test, y_pred):.4f}")
print(f"Recall: {recall_score(y_test, y_pred):.4f}")
print(f"F1-Score: {f1_score(y_test, y_pred):.4f}")
```

sections.title: Example 4: XGBoost with Cross-Validation
sections.body:
```python
print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("Example 4: XGBoost with Cross-Validation")
print("=" * 80)

xgb_cv = xgb.XGBClassifier(
    n_estimators=100, learning_rate=0.1, max_depth=6, random_state=42
)

# Cross-validation
cv_scores = cross_val_score(xgb_cv, X_train, y_train, cv=5, scoring="f1")
print(f"Cross-Validation F1 Scores: {cv_scores}")
print(f"Mean CV F1: {cv_scores.mean():.4f} (+/- {cv_scores.std() * 2:.4f})")
```

sections.title: Example 5: XGBoost with Custom Loss Function
sections.body:
```python
print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("Example 5: XGBoost with Custom Loss Function")
print("=" * 80)

# XGBoost with different objectives
xgb_custom = xgb.XGBClassifier(
    n_estimators=100,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    max_depth=6,
    objective="binary:logistic",  # Binary classification
    random_state=42,
)

xgb_custom.fit(X_train, y_train)
y_pred_proba = xgb_custom.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
y_pred = (y_pred_proba > 0.5).astype(int)

print("XGBoost with Custom Loss Results:")
print(f"Accuracy: {accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred):.4f}")
print(f"Precision: {precision_score(y_test, y_pred):.4f}")
print(f"Recall: {recall_score(y_test, y_pred):.4f}")
print(f"F1-Score: {f1_score(y_test, y_pred):.4f}")
```

sections.title: Example 6: XGBoost Feature Analysis
sections.body:
```python
print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("Example 6: XGBoost Feature Analysis")
print("=" * 80)

# Train model for feature analysis
xgb_analysis = xgb.XGBClassifier(
    n_estimators=100, learning_rate=0.1, max_depth=6, random_state=42
)

xgb_analysis.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Get different types of feature importance
print("Feature Importance Analysis:")
print("-" * 50)

# Weight-based importance
weight_importance = xgb_analysis.feature_importances_
print("Weight-based importance (top 5):")
top_weight = np.argsort(weight_importance)[-5:]
for i, feature_idx in enumerate(top_weight):
    print(f"Feature {feature_idx:2d}: {weight_importance[feature_idx]:.4f}")

# Gain-based importance
gain_importance = xgb_analysis.get_booster().get_score(importance_type="gain")
print(f"\nGain-based importance (top 5):")
sorted_gain = sorted(gain_importance.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)[:5]
for feature, gain in sorted_gain:
    print(f"Feature {feature}: {gain:.4f}")
```
